Power Systems Engineering (M.Tech. - 2yrs)

Programme Outcomes (POs)
1 An ability to independently carry out research /investigation and development work to solve practical problems
2 An ability to write and present a substantial technical report/document
3 Students should be able to demonstrate a degree of mastery over the area as per the specialization of the program. The mastery should be at a level higher than the requirements in the appropriate bachelor program
4 Able to apply interdisciplinary and modern techniques to carry out system design, testing, verification and realization under real-time constraints in the field of Power Systems with appropriate consideration for safety and environmental issues independently.
5 An ability to take up challenging problems in the field of power systems engineering and serve power systems utilities, industries, research organizations and educational institutions.
6 Students should be able to develop confidence for self-education and ability for life-long learning and understand the impact of engineering on society and demonstrate awareness of contemporary issues, commit to professional ethics, norms of engineering technology and practice.
Program Educational Objectives (PEOs)
1 To impart professional knowledge in the field of Power Systems Engineering and enhance analytical skills to solve complex problems in power utilities and industries using advanced technologies, which are economically feasible and socially acceptable.
2 To enhance the students capacity in pursuing research in emerging areas of Power Systems Engineering and inculcate the culture of taking research projects on state-of-art technologies in smart grid, green energy, e-mobility, etc.
3 To provide opportunities to students, for working as a part of teams, pursuing multidisciplinary projects and product development for industrial applications.
4 To build strong foundations in Power Systems Engineering to pursue higher studies and excel in the field of teaching and research at national and international levels.
5 To exhibit professionalism, ethical attitude, communication skills, team work in their profession and adapt to modern trends by engaging in life-long learning leading towards an enlightened society.
Program Specific Outcomes (PSOs)
1 Post Graduates will be able to Explore the scientific theories, methodologies and modern technologies in planning, designing, installation and commissioning, control and maintenance of conventional and renewable power systems.
2 Post Graduates will be able to Apply the knowledge of multidisciplinary areas such as power electronics, instrumentation, soft computing techniques etc. in the field of power systems to create inventive, vibrant and challenging environment, for the research-based teamwork.
3 Post Graduates will be able to Develop the suitable techniques with state of the art facility and cutting-edge engineering hardware and software to solve problems in the domain of power system engineering.
